title: G21 · 拒绝
body: I kept five proven functions unchanged and targeted the three clearest sources of avoidable work: word-frequency entries are now replaced by directly sorted count buckets, matrix multiplication gains cache-blocked transposition and traversal plus sixteen-way k unrolling without changing accumulation order, and prime output no longer repeatedly grows its backing array. The changes preserve strict and lexical ordering, exact matrix arithmetic, dense outputs, and argument immutability; conservatively projected paired gains are 1.18×, 1.25×, and 1.08×, respectively, giving enough projected aggregate headroom for acceptance.
